studioPattern.localAdaptation: Early Grow project scaffold with GitHub connection notes; product scope and runtime stack are still TBD.

projectState.summary: The repo has a Studio Pattern scaffold, GitHub setup notes, and an initial plan for a browser-first local Ollama-powered musical terrarium. Claude reviewed the byte-by-byte implementation plan. Current Byte 1 is a Vite/TypeScript + PixiJS/Tone.js page with bounded terrarium, one stationary pulse player, one percussive beat, start/stop controls, status readout, explicit Tone.js lifecycle cleanup, and stable test hooks.
